THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
019
STUDY 016
Jade Backdrop & Hairpin
Rights check
Source: 5089.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
A vertical, tightly framed studio portrait of an original
young woman with dark hair pulled back into a low,
smooth bun, secured with an ornamental hairpin whose
carved, pale ornament sits at the side of her head. Her
skin is fair and luminous, with defined brows, soft eye
makeup, and a deep red lip. She wears a fitted black
top with a crisp white V-shaped collar that sits high at
the neckline. Her expression is calm, composed, and
direct. The background is a deep, muted jade-teal
backdrop with soft, even tonal gradation. Soft, low-key
studio lighting with a gentle falloff into shadow, a palette
of jade, charcoal black, and ivory white with a single red
accent at the lips. Subtle film grain and a slightly faded
print finish. Quiet, elegant, and moody, in the style of a
fine-art editorial portrait.
Quiet, elegant, moody
WORKING NOTES
- The jade backdrop and the single red lip are the key
color contrast; keep both specific.
- The hairpin is a strong detail; name the ornament
material (for example, carved jade or pearl) to control its
look.
Try this: Specify the hairpin material.
